Alger, 10 septembre 2026 (Algeria Tech): Algiers, September 10, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The High Commission for Digitization and the Ministry of National Education are launching a new service on the Dzair Digital Services portal. Procedures for the 2026-2027 school year will be handled online starting September 13.
Déploiement de l'Espace Parents d'élèves: Deployment of the Parents' Space service
Une nouvelle prestation dématérialisée i: A new digital service is joining the national Dzair Digital Services portal. Designed in partnership with the Ministry of National Education, this "Parents' Space" enables families to complete two procedures remotely. Families can process preschool registration and exceptional first-year primary school registration.
Ce dispositif concrétise les directives: This initiative implements the directives of the President of the Republic, Mr. Abdelmadjid Tebboune. The approach aims to expand access to online public services, simplify daily life, and save users' time.
Le Haut-Commissariat à la Numérisation (: The High Commission for Digitization (HCN) describes this launch as a technical milestone. The institution plans to integrate other digital services onto the platform in the coming weeks.
Intégration du service « Espace Parents: Integration of the "Parents' Space" service onto the Dzair Digital Services platform.
Dématérialisation des inscriptions pour: Digitization of registrations for preschool and the first year of primary school.
Calendrier de dépôt des demandes fixé du: Application submission schedule set from September 13 to September 24, 2026.
Projet conduit par le Haut-Commissariat: Project led by the High Commission for Digitization and the Ministry of National Education.
Mesure conforme aux orientations du prés: Measure in accordance with the guidelines of the President of the Republic, Mr. Abdelmadjid Tebboune.
Déploiement de nouveaux services publics: Deployment of new digital public services planned during the coming weeks.
